O03

Optional course FAQ assistant

/courses/:courseId/assistant
Roles: studentScope: optionalPriority: optional

Offer a later optional course FAQ/navigation assistant grounded only in current learner-visible course material with inspectable citations.

Question/answerUser question, bounded cited answer and uncertainty notice
Sources/recoveryPublished page citations with versions and links, clear context reset and course discussion route

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Clear assistant context
  • Current local questions/answers will disappear
  • Coursework, receipts and feedback are unaffected
Return without applying changesClear local context
Permissions
  • Current learner reads assistant output based only on their existing course-content eligibility.
  • No staff grading tools, autonomous actions or cross-course private context; provider, data handling, evaluation and cost remain undecided.
Responsive
  • Narrow web places citations directly beneath each answer and keeps policy/disabled state above the question field.
  • Source previews open with a visible return; long questions wrap without horizontal scrolling. Clear context stays separate from Ask.
Accessibility
  • Use labelled question input and answer/source headings; cite links describe page title/version.
  • Announce response availability once, then let the learner read. Preserve focus in input after send; avoid streaming speech or timing-dependent interaction.
Data
  • Per-learner ephemeral local session, fictional question/answer and permitted published source/version references only; no provider request or API key.
  • Context excludes peers, hidden pages, answer keys, submissions and held results. Recheck source visibility before citation opening; clear session on learner/context change.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Held results, answer keys and peers' records never enter context or citations.
  • Course AI prohibition disables the assistant even if institution-level AI is otherwise allowed.
  • Unsupported answer states uncertainty and links ordinary course help; it cannot change work, deadlines or grades.
Notes
  • OPTIONAL proposal only; not adopted, implemented or backed by inference services. Initial HTML must label simulated answers.
  • No API keys, paid services, external tool entitlement or secure data-handling claims are assumed.
